candidate.text: Mara carries warm bread to the river. The careful pilot studies cloud maps. Children gather bright shells by moonlight. A gardener shelters young cedar shoots. Old friends share stories beside fire. By the hearth, new tales begin. Near the grove, small finches settle. At twilight, the patient tide returns. Beyond the hills, a quiet engine waits. At the shore, Owen listens for bells.
